article.title: CENTCOM top commander says no sign of IRGC in the Strait of Hormuz
paras: Editor's note: this story was translated from the original VOA Persian article.

The commander of the U.S. Central Command known as CENTCOM operating in the Middle East says Iran's Revolutionary Guard naval forces which once had a near constant presence in the strategic Strait of Hormuz have disappeared.
Admiral Brad Cooper was speaking on Friday after visiting the region earlier this week where over 10,000 U.S. forces are enforcing naval blockade on Iranian ports and oil terminals.

"When I flew over the strait, I saw dozens of commercial vessels transiting all types, cargo, crude oil, liquid natural gas, or LNG. And I also saw our U.S. assets in the air and on the water," he said in a video published by CENTCOM Friday.
"Here's what I didn't see. I didn't see the IRGC [Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps] out there, at all."

He said the U.S.-designated terror force's decades-long control of the waters and its harassment and threats, and seizure of commercial shipping has been decimated by the precision strikes of the U.S. military which sank Iran's navy vessels.
"They were not out there because Iran's navy is all at the bottom of the sea," he said.
Iran's Revolutionary Guard has long insisted it's in control of the strait and warned that any vessel attempting to pass the strait without prior approval from Tehran could be targeted.

On Friday, Iran's navy warned commercial vessels that the southern route close to Oman's coastline is "contaminated with mines," and threatened to hold the vessels’ owners and crews "responsible for using it," according to Iranian state media.
Iran's state news agency on Friday reported its navy destroyed a U.S. navy boat and that two tankers hit sea mines in the eastern side of Hormuz.
CENTCOM on Friday denied IRGC claims that it destroyed a U.S. military sea drone in the Strait of Hormuz.
"This claim is FALSE, just like many other IRGC lies this week," CENTCOM said in a post on X.
"All U.S. military unmanned surface vessels in the Middle East are accounted for, including a squadron of advanced sea drones on patrol in the Strait of Hormuz supporting CENTCOM's defensive layer."

The British maritime organization, UKMTO late Friday reported that a vessel has been hit by an unknown projectile on the port side, resulting fire. The incident occurred 40 nautical miles south of Lavan Island, Iran. Crews are safe and there is no reported environmental impact at this time, UKMTO said.
Cooper said the U.S. military has helped nations in the Persian Gulf export over 1.5 billion barrels of crude oil since the summer.
In contrast, he pointed out that due to the U.S. naval blockade of Iranian ports, Iran has been unable to export any oil since the U.S. reimposed the blockade in mid-July.
zh: 中央司令部最高指揮官表示，霍爾木茲海峽內未發現伊朗革命衛隊的蹤跡
編者註：本文翻譯自美國之音波斯語版原文。
駐紮中東的美國中央司令部（簡稱CENTCOM）指揮官表示，伊朗革命衛隊海軍部隊——該部隊曾幾乎長期駐紮於戰略要地霍爾木茲海峽——如今已消失無蹤。
布拉德·庫珀海軍上將於週五發表講話，此前他於本週稍早造訪了該地區，目前有超過一萬名美軍在該地區對伊朗港口及石油終端實施海上封鎖。
「當我飛越海峽時，我看到數十艘各類商用船隻正在通過，包括貨輪、原油運輸船以及液化天然氣（LNG）運輸船。我也看到我們美國在空中和水面的軍事資產，」他在美中央司令部（CENTCOM）週五發布的一段影片中表示。
「這是我沒看到的情況。我完全沒看到伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊（IRGC）出現在那裡。」
他表示，這支被美國列為恐怖組織的武裝力量，長期以來對該海域的控制、其騷擾與威脅行為，以及扣押商船的行徑，已因美軍的精準打擊而遭受重創——這些打擊擊沉了伊朗的海軍艦艇。
「他們之所以不在那裡，是因為伊朗的海軍全都沉在海底了，」他說道。
伊朗革命衛隊長期以來一直堅稱其掌控著該海峽，並警告稱，任何未經德黑蘭事先批准而試圖通過該海峽的船隻都可能成為攻擊目標。
據伊朗國營媒體報導，週五，伊朗海軍警告商船，靠近阿曼海岸線的南部航道「布滿水雷」，並威脅將追究船東及船員「使用該航道的責任」。
伊朗國家通訊社週五報導，該國海軍擊沉了一艘美國海軍船隻，且有兩艘油輪在霍爾木茲海峽東側觸雷。
中央司令部（CENTCOM）週五駁斥了伊朗革命衛隊（IRGC）聲稱其在霍爾木茲海峽摧毀一架美軍海上無人機的說法。
「這項說法是錯誤的，就像本週伊朗革命衛隊（IRGC）散布的許多其他謊言一樣，」中央司令部（CENTCOM）在 X 平台上的一則貼文中表示。
「駐紮中東的所有美國軍方無人水面艦艇均已確認位置，其中包括一支正在霍爾木茲海峽巡邏、支援中央司令部（CENTCOM）防禦體系的先進海上無人機編隊。」
英國海事組織 UKMTO 週五晚間通報，一艘船隻的左舷遭不明彈體擊中，引發火災。該事件發生於伊朗拉萬島以南 40 海里處。UKMTO 表示，船員均安全無恙，目前亦未接獲任何環境影響的報告。
庫珀表示，自今年夏天以來，美軍已協助波斯灣各國出口超過15億桶原油。
相較之下，他指出，由於美國對伊朗港口實施海上封鎖，自美國於七月中旬重新實施封鎖以來，伊朗便無法出口任何石油。
